text:
ellie: opened a tiny PR to reconcile the catalog variant table and add a short migration checklist for deprecated variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5257 :wave:

omar: quick skim 2 couple fixes: 1) bench link for nebula-lite moved, 2) the limits column mixes 'max_tokens' and 'max_sequence' which is confusing.

deepa: For the limits column, can we show 'tokens (max_tokens)' and 'context (max_sequence)' on stacked rows? small css but clearer.

ellie: will change to stacked rows and add a footnote explaining units and bench rig.

frances: also add a 1-line SDK snippet to show checking variant limits before pinning. folks forget concurrency and sequence. tiny example below: 

```python
from redwood import CatalogClient
cat = CatalogClient()
v = cat.get_variant("nebula-lite-v1")
print(v["limits"]["max_sequence"], v["limits"]["concurrency"])
```

omar: migration checklist suggestion: deterministic diff + canary:
- `redwood eval --model nebula-lite-legacy --model nebula-lite-v1 --prompt-file smoke.txt --temperature 0.0 --top_k 1 --output diffs.json`
- canary 5% for 24h, then 25% for 48h.

deepa: perf artifact check: /bench/nebula-lite/2026-03-20/nebula_lite.csv -> NOT FOUND. please coordinate with perf.

ellie: reached out to perf; they re-uploaded as /bench/nebula-lite/2026-03-27/nebula_lite_v2.csv. updated PR link.

docs-bot: lint: table cell >120 chars at /catalog/variants.md line 198. suggest moving rig annotation to footnote.

ellie: moved rig details (a100-40gb, seq=1024, dyn-batching=off) to footnote and shortened inline text. pushed.

frances: one more nit: mention quant fallback behavior briefly: "quant variants may reduce max_sequence on memory-constrained devices; verify limits before routing."

ellie: added that line. also swapped old `list_models()` snippet to `catalog.list_variants()` in SDK examples.

omar: approving once CI passes. leaving minor wording nits.

docs-bot: external links scan: /sdk/cli -> 301 redirect. recommend follow-up PR to update hrefs.

ellie: will open follow-up for CLI href fixes after landing this. merging after CI.:shipit:
